description: Defines the AppPreferences data class, which encapsulates user preferences for the application. It initializes several preferences with default values via the `defaultOf()` function imported from an external package.

classes.name: AppPreferences
classes.description: A data class representing various user preference settings such as layout, theme, sorting, backup strategies, date/time formats, media handling, and synchronization modes.

methods.name: defaultOf
methods.description: A function imported from an external package used to provide default values for each of the preference properties.
